description.value:
Once standard issue for Trauma Team International, the SBR-40 is rapidly losing out to newer Kang Tao offerings. Despite its shortcomings and age, some mercs still prefer the SBR-40 for its precision, stability, discretion, and lack of corpo-made AI-guidance systems (allegedly) storing their combat data.

Cost: 2,000eb (Very Expensive)

Class: EQ Assault Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Carbine

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: 25 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (SMG 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Carbine Barrel, Efficient Autosear, Short Scope, Silencer, Sling • Mods: None

Special Features: Using Autofire with this weapon expends 6 rounds instead of 10 [Efficient Autosear].

Range: Carbine
Pre-installed: Carbine Barrel, Efficient Autosear, Short Scope, Silencer, Sling (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (SMG 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
